definitions.short: a wrapped (and unformed mass, i.e. as the embryo)
definitions.full: H1564. golem [ גֹּ֫לֶם ] noun [masculine] embryo (Late Hebrew גּוֺלֶם , Aramaic גּוֺלְמָא , unfinished vessel ), עֵינֶיךָ רָאוּ גָּלְמִי Psa 139:16 mine imperfect substance (RV) did thine eyes see.
